title: RENDERED_DOCUMENT_EVIDENCE_V1
description: Runtime evidence schema of CAREER_OS_DOCUMENT_RENDERING_CAPABILITY_V1. The root validates one evidence record; $defs.child_frame validates one CHILD_PROTOCOL_V1 frame. Every check is labelled AUTOMATED or HUMAN_REQUIRED and human review can never be waived. Integers are JSON integers (a number with a fraction part, including 1.0, is not an integer for this schema). Stream-level rules (seq order, stage order, FINAL binding, line lengths, strictly ascending fd_state, start classification) are enforced by the parent stream validator, not by this schema.
